meta.name: review-work
meta.description: Post-implementation gate review: run manual QA on the real surface yourself, then launch ONE gate reviewer (never a panel) to audit goal, constraints, code quality, security, missed context, and QA evidence. Use before a PR handoff or when the user explicitly asks to review completed work.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自查并单审已完成工作，核验目标、质量与安全
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚完成功能开发，想在提交PR前做一次独立的把关审查。
copy.tagline_en: Gate-check completed work with a single reviewer before handoff.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just finished coding and want an independent check before a PR handoff.

howto.what: 装好后,当你请它审阅已完成的工作时,它会先在真实运行环境亲手做手工测试并逐条记录结果,再单独派一个评审子代理核对目标、约束与代码质量等;任何一条测试失败就直接报失败,测试全过且评审批准才算合格。
howto.when: 当你明确要求审阅已完成的工作时,或在准备提交 PR 之前,它会接管审查。

say.text: 请审阅我刚完成的功能改动。
say.note: 会先在真实环境亲手测试,再派评审子代理核查。

say.text: 我准备提 PR 了,先帮我审查这次改动。
say.note: 先收集目标、约束与改动清单,再执行测试与评审。

say.text: 检查这次改动有没有漏掉背景,或影响原本正常的相邻功能。
say.note: 会覆盖最易错场景,并做相邻功能的回归测试。

howto.what_en: Claude reviews finished work by running hands-on QA on the real app, then spawning one gate reviewer to audit goal, constraints, code quality, and evidence. Passes only when no QA row fails and the reviewer approves; otherwise it fails.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to review completed work, or right before handing off a pull request. It works as a post-implementation gate.

say_en.text: Please review the feature I just finished.
say_en.note: Runs hands-on QA first, then a gate reviewer checks it.

say_en.text: I am about to submit a PR — review this change first.
say_en.note: Gathers the goal, constraints, and diff, then runs QA.

say_en.text: Check this change for missed context or harm to adjacent features.
say_en.note: Covers risky edge cases and regression on neighboring behavior.
